places.name: Wagon-wreck creek near San Antonio
places.note: Bolivar's accidental shotgun blast stampedes the mules; the wagon flips off a cutbank onto Lippy, who survives, and Bol quits and heads home.
places.location_hint: small creek just crossed by the herd, before it had passed San Antonio; about a week north of Lonesome Dove

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: The accident happens before the herd has got past the city.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Bol plans to stop there on his way home to beat the dinner bell a few more times; he remembers easy life there.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: Bol has never been more than two days' ride from it and fears getting too far north to find his way back.

places.name: Bolivar's village
places.note: Bol's wife and daughters live there; old men there reminisce about stealing Texas cattle.
places.location_hint: in Mexico, about three days' ride beyond the Rio Grande from Lonesome Dove

places.name: Mexico
places.note: Bol's homeland; echoes of his dinner bell used to fade across into it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus tells Bol he can rejoin them there if he changes his mind.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Newt worries they will lose everyone before getting out of it; Bol's friends once stole its cattle.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: at the creek with a broken wagon, short of passing San Antonio

groups.label: Bolivar
groups.hint: riding south alone from near San Antonio toward Lonesome Dove and his Mexican village
